sections.title: General

Dry glazing and wet glazing option
Interlocking mullion design eliminates the need for anti-buckling clips
Concealed fastener joinery creates smooth, monolithic appearance

sections.title: General
items: Heights vary to 10 feet; widths range from approximately 3 to 4 feet
Door frame face widths range to a maximum of 4″ (101.6mm), while depths range to 6″ (152.4mm)
Door operation is single or double acting with maximum security locks or touch bar panics standard
Architect’s classic one inch round, bent bar push/pull hardware is available in various finishes and sizes
Infills range from 1/4″ (6.4) to 1″ (25.4)
Engineered for moderate traffic in applications such as stores, offices and apartment buildings
Vertical stile measures 2-1/8″ (54mm), top rail 2-1/4″ (57.2mm) and bottom rail 3-7/8″ (98.4mm)
Results in a slim look that meets virtually all construction requirements

notes: Performance To resist both lever arm and torsion forces that constantly act upon any door, the 350/500 Heavy Wall Entrance features four Sigma deep penetration and filet welds plus mechanical fastening at each corner.

Kawneer’s Paneline™ panic device can be incorporated into Heavy Wall Entrances for crowded buildings that require quick emergency egress. Pressure on the push panel quickly releases the door and Paneline offers improved safety over a traditional crash bar device.

sections.title: General
items: Two distinct looks – a sub-sash option for equal sightlines across the opening and a direct field-glazed option for a more traditional sliding door look with optional interior screens
2-1/4” (57.15mm) standard sill, with 15 psf water performance, provides a smaller sightline at the interior/exterior transition
Coped, screw spline joinery for easier fabrication and assembly
Pre-glazing of the sliding panel and sub-sash fixed panel with a common glass size for quicker glazing and installation
Open view slab-to-slab units that can span up to 10’ tall, providing occupants clear, unobstructed views

sections.title: General
items: A larger wheel, stainless steel tandem roller with precision ground sealed bearings, allows smooth operation of even the largest and heaviest sliding panels
Unique beveled profiles that create architectural shadow lines and permit a commercial product to receive mid- to high-rise residential acceptance
Meeting the challenges of high winds, heavy rain, blizzards and hurricanes, it offers a practical product solution for use on high-end condominiums, hotels and apartments
Fixed panels can be stacked via a common mullion to achieve even greater expanses of glass (OOXO) in addition to the standard OX, XO, OXO and OXXO openings

description.summary: The IR 521/521T/521UT Storefront Framing System leads the way for protection, aesthetics and thermal performance. Our first ever pre-glazed impact-rated storefront system combines thinner sightlines and ultra-thermal capabilities with Missile Level D and Level E impact protection and offers incredible installation versatility using pre-glazed framing members. It is designed and engineered for single-span storefronts, low- to mid-rise ribbon windows and punched opening applications. The system is available pre-glazed, either inside or outside glazed, to meet a diverse range of project requirements and is hurricane impact-tested against windborne debris with Florida Product Approval (FPA) and Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) evaluation, demonstrating superior protection and the ability to enhance the long-term value and provide occupant safety.

description.summary: The Trifab® 451UT Framing System is engineered for the most demanding thermal performance by employing a “dual” thermal break. A perfect choice for single-span storefront, ribbon window or punched openings, this screw spline fabricated system has center set glass and a pre-glazed option. The Trifab® 451UT Framing System offers a pre-glaze option for the existing center set screw spline assembly application, available on non-thermal, thermal and ultra-thermal frame types. Pre-glaze units can be completely fabricated and glazed in the shop, minimizing job-site costs and enhancing field-installed quality.

description.summary: Trifab® VersaGlaze® Framing System is built on the proven and successful Trifab® Framing platform – with all the versatility its name implies. original_data.name: System 4500 simulated hung-slider windows
summary: While the application of uPVC single-hung or double-hung windows in renovations of buildings with historical importance are technically possible, many of these renovations require much higher performing window designs including those that are commercially rated. Many PVC single and double hung designs do not attain commercial ratings and would therefore be unsuited to these applications.

The REHAU System 4500 tilt & turn window designs achieve excellent structural, thermal and sound insulating performance, can be fabricated in large sizes, require fewer profiles to stock and in general have more robust design properties than most hung-sash windows.

Meant for residential as well as commercial uses, the REHAU System 4500 is a popular choice for commercial as well as institutional applications by being able to have limited ventilation possibilities for the building occupants. The design of the hardware mechanisms can be configured to limit the sash operation to tilt only, allowing safe and secure ventilation at the top, making the window safe for use on upper floors of buildings. In this mode, the mechanisms can be unlocked by maintenance or janitorial personnel for cleaning or general maintenance.
The system is available in white, beige or clay and can be laminated with solid color or wood-grain foils.

original_data.name: System 4500 tilt-turn windows
summary: A very unique product for large openings in both residential and commercial markets.The tilt-turn is the dominant window style in Europe, now gaining popularity among discerning architects, designers and homeowners in North America. The System 4500 is a versatile design featuring three windows in one: An inward opening casement in the turn position, a secure top-venting hopper in the tilt position and a tightly sealed picture window when closed.
Matching doors in a variety of configurations are available.The system is available in white, beige or clay and can be laminated with solid color or wood-grain foils.

original_data.name: System 4500 tilt-slide doors
summary: The REHAU System 4500 Tilt-Slide Door design is a premium door solution for spaces that do not allow for traditional inswing doors. With just a simple turn of a handle, the door sash can be tilted providing secure ventilation. With another turn, the sash slides open parallel to the fixed unit, not into the room, for space-saving functionality. High-quality European hardware system operates quietly and easily.The optimal profile design and compression-seal technology contribute to outstanding performance. Matching fixed and operable windows can be paired with this door
Matching windows in a variety of configurations are available.The system is available in white, beige or clay and can be laminated with solid color or wood-grain foils.

original_data.name: System 4500 hinged / french doors
summary: Few designs are more classic or have as many different uses as hinged doors. Hinged doors are offered as a single sash creating a beautiful main entrance or as dual sash, also referred to as French doors, connecting the indoors with the outdoors. These versatile doors can be used for patio, deck or balcony access.The System 4500 Hinged Door design offers an attractive solution for both residential and commercial applications. Matching fixed and operable windows can be paired with this door as top and side lites allowing for the greatest design flexibility. With the System 4500 hinged door design, single inswing and outswing as well as double inswing and outswing configurations are possible.
Matching windows in a variety of configurations are available.The system is available in white, beige or clay and can be laminated with solid color or wood-grain foils.

original_data.name: EXELIS 190 hung-slider windows
summary: A window that combines the simplicity of a side-load design with high performance, suitable for both new construction and replacement projects.Our System 190 Hung-Slider system offers different frame options for accessory grooves, integral nailing and/or stucco fin.With the System 190 design, single hung, single slider and fixed configurations are possible. intro: Designed for blast mitigation in government, public, civic, office, healthcare, education and other commercial buildings with light to moderate traffic, Tubelite ForceFront® Blast (FFB) Standard Medium Stile Entrance systems:
features: Meet high levels of hazard mitigation for Department of Defense (DoD), General Service Administration (GSA) and Veterans Affairs (VA) projects
Are tested to withstand blast loads up to 36.4 psi / 84.0 psi-msec (76’ standoff charge weight I and 32’ standoff charge weight II) in accordance with UFC 4-010-01
3′ by 7′ single doors with tie-rod construction
1-3/4″ by 4″ vertical stiles and top rail
Allowance for several thicknesses of laminated glazing and laminated IGUs
A choice of glazing methods, sills, mid-rails and hardware
Optional heavy wall extrusions and steel reinforcing
closing: These blast-mitigating entrances feature:
Tubelite offers in-house technical assistance to support each project, which must be analyzed separately for compliance with its unique factors.

Tubelite architectural aluminum entrances use a steel tie rod construction that is both strong and flexible, and backed with a lifetime warranty. As durable as welded corner construction, tie-rod assembly offers additional advantages, allowing the doors to be modified, disassembled or resized right in the field.
Our entrances systems easily integrate with Tubelite blast-mitigating storefront and curtain wall systems. Durable anodized and painted finishes provide long-lasting protection and color options.

notes: Listed performance dependent on glass selection. Specific details found in test data. Contact your sales representative for more information. Product performance information subject to change.

description.summary: Designed for blast-mitigating, energy-efficient buildings’ low- and mid-rise applications, Tubelite ForceFront® Blast (FFB) T34000 Series Storefront systems:
intro: Designed for blast-mitigating, energy-efficient buildings’ low- and mid-rise applications, Tubelite ForceFront® Blast (FFB) T34000 Series Storefront systems:

• meet high levels of hazard mitigation requirements of ASTM, Department of Defense (DoD) and General Service Administration (GSA) Interagency Security Committee (ISC) • are tested to withstand blast loads in accordance with UFC 4-010-01 (121’ standoff charge weight I and 50’ standoff charge weight II)
These high-performance storefront systems feature:

• thermally broken framing with single-cavity poured-and-debridged (P&D) thermal barrier • 2-1/2″ by 5″ aluminum framing profiles • allowance for 1-5/16″ laminated glazing or IGUs • exterior center-set, flush-glazed • screw-spline construction
Tubelite offers in-house technical assistance to support each project, which must be analyzed separately for compliance with its unique factors.

For a complete blast hazard mitigating system that is easy to fabricate and install, our storefront framing also is compatible with Tubelite ForceFront Blast Curtain Wall, Standard and Monumental Entrance systems. Durable anodized and painted finishes provide long-lasting protection and color options.
This blast-resistant storefront is ideal for government, public, civic, retail, office, healthcare, education and other commercial buildings.
notes: Listed performance dependent on glass selection. Specific details found in test data. Contact your sales representative for more information. Product performance information subject to change.

description.summary: Blending transparency and flexibility within commercial spaces, the Tubelite INT14 Interior Flush Glaze Framing System offers versatile design options for floor-to-ceiling room enclosures, partial-height partitions or free-standing applications.
intro: Blending transparency and flexibility within commercial spaces, the Tubelite INT14 Interior Flush Glaze Framing System offers versatile design options for floor-to-ceiling room enclosures, partial-height partitions or free-standing applications.

Engineered to interface easily with typical metal stud and drywall construction, Tubelite INT14 aluminum framing can be installed either before the drywall, after the drywall to completely cover the end of the stud wall, or as a self-supporting system.
The Tubelite INT14 system is a full flush-glazed interior aluminum framing system available in multiple configurations. It features:

• 2″ face width and 4-1/2″ overall depth • allowance for 1/2″ glazing as standard • no need for adaptors for 1/4″ to 3/4″ glazing or infill panel options • adaptor options also available for 1/4″ to 3/4″ infill panels • black or gray gasket colors • 90-degree, 180-degree and “T” post mullion/corner options
Rotational mullions allow angular wall corners greater than 90-degrees. Butt-glazed details in both standard storefront and channel-style head and sill options also are available.

For quiet interiors, high-performance acoustic glazing in standard 1/2″ laminated glass thickness has been tested to achieve a Sound Transmission Class (STC) of 34 and an Outdoor Indoor Transmission Class (OITC) of 32. Paired with Tubelite side-hinged doors and entrance systems, Tubelite interior framing system delivers a comprehensive solution for fast-track construction and renovation project build-outs for retail, office, education and other commercial interior spaces. Specify with recycled content for projects’ sustainable goals and LEED documentation.

Enhancing interior design and décor, Tubelite interior framing and door systems can be finished in a full selection of durable, standard architectural paint and anodize colors. Specialty and custom finishes also can be selected.
notes: Listed performance dependent on glass selection. Specific details found in test data. Contact your sales representative for more information. Product performance information subject to change.

closing: Tubelite MaxBlock aluminum sun shades manage solar heat gain by shading vision glass, allow natural light into the building envelope without obscuring the view and add distinctive visual elements. Reducing solar heat gain and the corresponding cooling demands can save utility expenses with energy-efficient performance, while supporting comfortable interiors. The beneficial attributes of these shading devices may contribute to projects seeking certification through U.S. Green Building Council’s LEED® rating systems, and other performance-based environmental and wellness programs.

Saving installation time, labor and associated costs, Tubelite MaxBlock multiblade sun control devices are engineered with a unique, detachable mounting bracket. It fastens at the pressure plate area and is attached to the outriggers using simple screw-spline connections. The bracket easily integrates with our curtain wall, window wall and storefront systems, including our thermal performance products. The patent-pending bracket design also can be detached in individual sections to accommodate future reglazing applications.

The aerodynamic design of the sun shades’ large, horizontal, airfoil blades direct wind and water out and away from the building. Protecting the aluminum and enhancing designs, the sun shades can be finished in choice of durable anodize, colorful painted coatings or specialty options such as simulated woodgrain finishes.
Our sun control systems are ideal for retail, office, healthcare, education, hospitality, government, multifamily and other commercial building applications.

intro: Designed for office, healthcare, education and other commercial buildings with heavy traffic, Tubelite Monumental Medium Stile Entrance systems feature:

• 4′ by 9′ single doors with tie-rod construction • 2″ by 3 1/2″ vertical stiles and top rail • 6″ bottom rail with a 10″ option for ADA compliance, other options available • Optional intermediate horizontal or vertical mid-rails and double doors up to 10′ high with engineering approval • Allowance for 3/16″ to 1″ glazing or infill panels
Our “blade” style glass stops and built in glass jacks make it easier to align the door with the frame during installation.

intro: Let fresh air into the building using natural ventilation with Tubelite’s Phantom® 4000CW Series Windows. Designed for mid- to high-rise commercial buildings, these operable vents integrate seamlessly within storefront, curtain wall, and window wall systems to deliver architectural-grade performance, modern aesthetics, and long-term reliability.

The Phantom 4000CW Series includes project-out awning and casement vent options, engineered to complement a wide range of Tubelite framing systems including 400T, 400SS, 400TU curtain wall, as well as 900T/TU window wall and E14000 I/O, T14000 I/O, and E/T24650 systems (outboard plane only).
features: 3-1/2″ (88.9mm) aluminum frame depth for dual-glazed IGUs
Mitered and sealed corners, crimped to “L”-shaped clips for structural integrity
Two-color finish capability for interior and exterior surfaces
Maximum vent size up to 36-1/4″ x 60-1/4″ (921mm x 1530mm) with Euro multi-point lock (MPL)
Linear handles with Roto operator or Euro-Groove multi-point locking
Adjustable hardware available in gray (silver) or black
White painted hardware available by special order (extended lead time)
Multi-chambered rain screen with pressure-equalized design
EPDM setting blocks for long-lasting sealing
Optional screens in fiberglass or aluminum (wicket screens available)
Factory-fabricated only, with a standard 2-year warranty (extendable to 5 years)

Phantom 4000CW Series vents are tested to meet CW Architectural Performance Class per NAFS-21 and AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440-19 standards. This includes rigorous testing for air, water, and structural performance, as well as lifecycle durability to 4,000 operating cycles, ensuring long-term occupant comfort, safety, and energy efficiency.

description.summary: Designed for retail, hospitality and other commercial buildings with moderate to heavy traffic, Tubelite Standard Medium Stile Entrance systems feature:
intro: Designed for retail, hospitality and other commercial buildings with moderate to heavy traffic, Tubelite Standard Medium Stile Entrance systems feature:

• 4′ by 9′ single doors with tie-rod construction • 1-3/4″ by 3-1/2″ vertical stiles and top rail • 6-1/2″ bottom rail with a 10″ option for ADA compliance • Optional intermediate horizontal or vertical mid-rails and double doors up to 10′ high with engineering approval • Allowance for 3/16″ to 1″ glazing or infill panels
Our “blade” style glass stops and built in glass jacks make it easier to align the door with the frame during installation.

Tubelite architectural aluminum entrances use a steel tie rod construction that is both strong and flexible, and backed with a lifetime warranty. This tie rod assembly is as durable as welded corner construction, but also lets you modify, disassemble or resize the doors on site. The door hardware includes a pull handle and a push bar, with the lock positioned 36″ above the finished floor.

Our entrance systems easily integrate with Tubelite storefront and curtain wall systems. Durable anodized and painted finishes provide long-lasting protection and a wide range of color choices for all Tubelite Entrance systems. Stock doors and frames are anodized in clear, dark bronze or black finishes, and are available for quick delivery.

description.summary: VersaTherm Storefront Framing is our most versatile and economical storefront framing system.
intro: VersaTherm Storefront Framing is our most versatile and economical storefront framing system.

The flexible design allows for on-site fabrication in applications ranging from punched openings to mall fronts. VersaTherm is available in a large selection of profiles. Snap on covers and back members, available in a variety of colors, allow for contrasting interior and exterior finishes. Finish options and glass positioning from frame exterior to center meet a wide range of aesthetic requirements.

Snap on covers and back members are “locked” together by a unique thermal barrier clip. This clip ensures that interior and exterior metal members remain separate while firmly connected, virtually eliminating the transference of frost and condensation. High-performance verticals and compatibility with Tubelite stock doors create a complete and truly versatile system.

original_data.name: Luminance® Light Shelf System
original_data.description: The YKK AP Luminance® Light Shelf system incorporates modern design elements and maintenance features offering the most attractive and functional light shelf system on the market.
original_data.long_description: This unique system is constructed from high quality aluminum extrusions and a lightweight, rigid honeycomb core panel with a durable melamine surface. Luminance incorporates a unique assembly process that includes a tiltdown panel feature allowing easy maintenance of the light reflecting surface and the glazing above it. This surface is highly reflective and slightly textured, yielding a penetrating, diffused light deeper into the interior space. Luminance is the ideal complement to YKK AP’s ThermaShade® and together provides a complete sun control solution.

original_data.name: YSK 750 - Slope Glazed Framing System for Curtain Walls
original_data.description: YSK 750 is a complete slope glazed framing system designed for walls with long rafters. The system incorporates an integral gutter that may be set directly down onto a curb or on top of a vertical curtain wall.
original_data.long_description: The unique hinge will accommodate slope angles from fifteen to sixty degrees and provide positive anchorage for the slope. original_data.description: YCN 40 T is a thermally broken, offset, front loaded 4-inch ribbon storefront framing system designed for a clean, open look without exposed fasteners.
original_data.long_description: YCN 40 T is thermally broken by means of MegaTherm® technology. The design of the thermal break permits the architect to select one finish on the exterior and a different finish on the interior. Sill construction provides for positive weepage of moisture to the exterior. Known as a “Stacking/Can System,” the YCN 40 T system offers the installer many labor saving advantages. YCN 40 T accommodates our hinged mullion, accepts 1″ glazing, and is available for exterior glazing.

original_data.long_description: The 3” face dimension ensures recommended glass clearances are maintained. Dry glazing options (for all design pressure ranges) slash installation time for quicker building dry-in. “Essential Facilities,” such as hospitals, fire stations and shelters, must remain functional during a storm. Evacuation isn’t practical or even possible in many cases. The ASTM E 1886 / 1996 standard provides a test protocol for “Essential Facilities” that for years was not economically feasible for glazed products. At 80 feet per second, a Level E missile impact produces more than twice the impact energy of the widely recognized Large Missile Level D. Design flexibility was a priority in the development process. Maximum glass size is 5’ x 8’ and can be incorporated into typical single span and multiple span applications. The combination of system design, dry glazing and inner layer selection has enabled us to offer the most price competitive “Essential Facility” system in the market.
